real_defects.issue: svc-pipe-to-shell (high) missed `curl ... | /bin/bash`, `| sudo -E bash`, `| sudo -u app /bin/sh` and `| /usr/bin/env bash`: the regex only accepted a bare shell name after an optional bare `sudo`. Same regex in classify.mjs (browser copy). Fixed in both; tests in test_check.py and four parity cases.

remote-pipe-to-shell missed `curl ... | /bin/bash`, `| sudo -E bash`, `| /usr/bin/env bash`, `| env python3`: RE_SHELL_INTERP_START took only a bare interpreter after a bare sudo. Found by searching siblings for the systemd checker's defect. Fixed with six tests in calc.test.mjs.

certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
